summary.note: Field-mediated resource competition (interact=field x conflict=competitive, Ring-1 combination cell). Huisman-Weissing competitive chaos: species compete through shared depletable resources and coexist via SUSTAINED oscillation (never a fixed point). Discriminator = multi-species coexistence + sustained abundance oscillation; the stable-coexistence control (same coexistence, no oscillation) is rejected, so the signature is the non-equilibrium dynamics. TNR 1.0.
